description: This file defines a React component 'Toolbar' that provides a control bar with various actions for a Kanban board. It includes features such as adding columns, exporting/importing cards via CSV and Excel, undoing CSV sync, toggling fullscreen, and other user interface controls. The file also contains utility functions for generating Excel templates and handling file uploads.

methods.name: downloadExcelTemplate()
methods.description: Generates and saves an Excel template file with predefined columns and a sample task, for use as a CSV import template.

methods.name: handleAddColumn
methods.description: Sets state to show modal for adding a new column.

methods.name: handleAddColumnSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of new column addition, adding the column via addColumn().

methods.name: handleExcelUpload
methods.description: Reads uploaded Excel file, parses its content, and prompts user to select a column for bulk upload.

methods.name: handleConfirmBulkUpload
methods.description: Processes bulk upload of cards based on selected column and parsed Excel data.

methods.name: handleExportCardsCsv
methods.description: Exports current cards to CSV file and triggers browser download.

methods.name: handleCsvFileSelected
methods.description: Reads uploaded CSV file, previews the data, and prompts for sync confirmation.

methods.name: handleConfirmCsvSync
methods.description: Performs CSV sync, updating and inserting cards, with undo support.

methods.name: handleUndoCsvSync
methods.description: Undoes the last CSV synchronization if available.

methods.name: Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })

ctags.name: Toolbar
ctags.pattern: /^function Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })
